# Write-free e2e: catalog show extended coverage (tui, distribution, empty
# id, unknown id) — bead go-foundry-cli-wet.2.4. Base coverage (core, cli,
# unknown) lives in catalog.txt.

# show tui archetype.
exec foundry catalog show tui
stdout 'id=tui'
stdout 'kind=archetype'
stdout 'catalog_digest='
! stderr .

exec foundry catalog show tui --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"id":"tui"'
stdout '"kind":"archetype"'
stdout '"catalog_digest"'
! stderr .

# show distribution profile.
exec foundry catalog show distribution
stdout 'id=distribution'
stdout 'kind=profile'
stdout 'catalog_digest='
! stderr .

exec foundry catalog show distribution --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"id":"distribution"'
stdout '"kind":"profile"'
stdout '"catalog_digest"'
! stderr .

# Missing id (no positional arg) — cobra ExactArgs(1) usage error.
! exec foundry catalog show
stderr 'usage.invalid|accepts 1 arg'

# Empty-string id — one positional arg, but empty; fails closed as an
# unknown/invalid unit, never a silent match (exact-ids-only, no fuzzy).
! exec foundry catalog show ''
assert_error_id stderr catalog.invalid
stderr 'available units'

! exec foundry catalog show '' --output json
assert_error_id stdout catalog.invalid
stdout '"ok":false'
! stderr .
